question: What eternal attainment follows absorption into that non-bodily reality?
premises: One becomes absorbed in that reality.
In that absorption one becomes of that nature.
One finds the self as the eternal state.
inference: Absorption into that reality yields realization of the self as the eternal state.
uncertainties: The form śvāśvataṃ appears non-standard; taken as equivalent to śāśvatam.
plain_english: Absorbed in that, becoming of that nature, one finds the self as the eternal state.
